I am an old woman now, sixty years, and this small maize plot near my house feeds my family. I have some schooling so I know fertilizer helps, and the government extension people have been telling us for years to use DAP and urea on maize — I will buy a little if the price is not too high this season, but only a small amount because money is tight. I keep a few cattle so I spread manure from the kraal on this plot like my mother taught me, and I will plant the improved BH maize seed I bought from the cooperative because it gives more than the local seed. I cannot irrigate here, I depend on the belg and meher rains, and at my age I will do most of the weeding myself with help from my children, maybe hire a young man for a few days at planting and harvest.
